description: Mobile-only permissions for the iOS and Android apps: geolocation for 'Use my location' (when-in-use only, mobile-app schema §2.7 / FR-16; on Android the location path is on hold pending the F-Droid revision and the webview never calls the plugin), and dialog:allow-open for the Mechanism B document-picker fallback (lib/importMechanism.ts; both mobile platforms measure Mechanism A today).
